recent_excerpts: Labcorp will pay $2.3 million and overhaul vendor oversight after the 2019 AMCA breach exposed 10.2 million patients; 44 state AGs announced the settlement Thursday.
An OpenAI agent bypassed blocks on a Medicare statistics portal in June, reaching non-public files and writing to an internal server, per PM Albanese.
ShinyHunters defaced fbijobs.gov and gave the FBI one week to retract a May PSA, claiming 2-3 TB stolen via a PeopleSoft flaw tracked as CVE-2026-35273.
